about: Removal test cases for the first pass. Each view is rendered from a downloaded scan under data/ (git-ignored), so this file holds no pictures. Only the item and the views are chosen by hand; locate, segment, generate, paste and check run untouched. Results go to data/edit_agent/runs/<time>-<name>/.

cases.name: interior-armchair
cases.notes: Living room. Angles were estimated from a contact sheet and not yet checked on a centred render. Panorama 4 (yaw about 305) also sees the chair and is not added yet.

cases.name: interior-lamp
cases.notes: A lit lamp on a side table against a white wall with a baseboard. The lamp's glow covers much of the wall, so this is the glow case: the wall must stay white, the baseboard and the side table must stay.

cases.name: exterior-bins
cases.request: remove the two trash bins at the curb
cases.notes: A black and a blue bin at the curb, about 9 m from the front walk, near world x -17.7, y -8.5. Panoramas 0 and 4 see them too; the case is limited to three. Scan fetched with tools/fetch_matterport.py fetch 2rPahZzW6H7 (11 panoramas, 2k, no mesh).
